summary: Master adaptive management for development programmes with CLA, adaptive M&E, and reporting tools. Learn to adapt, evidence, and report with confidence.
lede: Adaptive management for development programmes uses evidence and feedback to guide adjustments when delivery conditions change. For programme managers and monitoring, evaluation and learning professionals, the training develops practical skills in context analysis, learning agenda design and maintaining decision logs. Participants also practise revising adaptive workplans, setting pivot protocols, integrating stakeholder feedback and designing results dashboards for clear reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for development professionals who already work with programme delivery, monitoring, partner coordination, or reporting and need stronger adaptive management capability. You will benefit most if your role involves translating field evidence into programme decisions, reporting, and course corrections.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, spreadsheet skills, and a working understanding of development programme delivery or MEL processes. You will also benefit from bringing a current programme example, a logframe, a Theory of Change, or a reporting template from your own work.
